'use strict';async (__vite_ssr_exports__,__vite_ssr_import_meta__,__vite_ssr_import__,__vite_ssr_dynamic_import__,__vite_ssr_exportAll__,__vite_ssr_exportName__,__filename,__dirname,module,exports,require)=>{{__vite_ssr_exportName__("assertSkillsAvailable", () => { try { return assertSkillsAvailable } catch {} });
function assertSkillsAvailable(requirements, registry) {
	const missing = [];
	for (const requirement of requirements) {
		const registered = registry.get(requirement.id);
		if (!registered) {
			missing.push(requirement.version ? `${requirement.id}@${requirement.version} ausente` : `${requirement.id} ausente`);
			continue;
		};
		if (requirement.version !== undefined && requirement.version !== registered.version) {
			missing.push(`${requirement.id}@${requirement.version} pedida, registrada ${registered.version}`);
		}
	};
	if (missing.length > 0) {
		throw new Error(`skills indisponíveis: ${missing.join("; ")}`);
	}
}
